name: com.mobileads.manager
description: Universal Mobile Ads management package for Unity (inspired by Gley Mobile Ads). Features a unified static API, Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) & Unity Ads support, GDPR/UMP Consent management, intelligent auto-reload with retry backoff, Remove-Ads IAP handling, and a realistic In-Editor Ad Simulator.

samples.description: Interactive demo UI showcasing Banners, Interstitials, Rewarded Ads, App Open Ads, UMP Consent, and Remove-Ads handling.
